purpose: Versioned inventory of approved policy, implementation references and production acceptance obligations. Not executable configuration.
implementation_note: Linked code and tests provide traceability, not proof that every production writer or scenario is verified. Existing apply commands are guarded to the Railway workspace. Production must validate a fresh source and exact cohorts.
rule_precedence: Preserve original facts and resolve creator evidence before historical provider collection assertions.
Resolve operator and frozen historical ownership independently of the creator's employer or current venue assignment.
Exclude skipped/cancelled/refunded/failed/disputed records from historical cash assertions; keep unpaid staff bookings pending.
Staff-entered court bookings have no platform fee; separately charged hosted-event fees remain independent.
Preserve saved quotes, explicit receipt links and actual deposit arrangements before considering a fallback.
Apply approved missing-fee fallback only to its mapped historical cohort; exact payment exceptions cannot become blanket rules.
Verify each receipt's disjoint allocations and classify unresolved evidence honestly.

rules.rule: Use created_by, authenticated creation entry point and corroborating creation history to distinguish staff and customer. user_id is the booking customer. Later collector, payment method, generic legacy bookboll_web and current role alone are not proof. Staff using customer checkout can be a customer-origin booking. Preserve unknown evidence.
rules.production_acceptance: Verify all entry points and immutable source evidence; audit nonmanual creation-context writes as well as manual monetary reclassification.

rules.rule: The actual paid external-provider online deposit is entirely Bookboll platform fee. The remaining arrival amount belongs to that provider. Keep marketplace and provider-site channels separate; use saved amount/rate, not today's configuration.
rules.production_acceptance: Provider cash and pending balances never enter Bookboll received, pending or debt. Disclose provider's own collections in its dashboard.

rules.rule: Gross online receipt equals its saved platform fee plus provider share. Link children to the gross receipt and count only disjoint allocations. Provider allocated income does not prove a bank payout.
rules.production_acceptance: Verify Stripe Connect fees/transfers and replay in test mode. Unknown original splits need evidence or review; never infer provider-owned gross as Bookboll revenue.

rules.rule: Own-venue customer receipts separate platform fee from venue remainder for every payment method. Deposit goes to platform and its arrival balance to venue. Full online/full arrival use saved quote. Payment method and business-unit recipient are distinct dimensions.
rules.production_acceptance: Paid and pending allocations conserve each source receipt; full refunds inherit to both children; saved fee/loyalty evidence is preserved.

rules.rule: Staff-entered court bookings have zero platform fee. Own venue: 100% venue revenue. External venue: 100% provider revenue. Operator identity, not creator employer, selects recipient. Unpaid remains pending.
rules.owner_confirmation: Keep manual bookings entirely as venue revenue
rules.production_acceptance: Classify creator before any historical arrival-paid assertion; payment method is not a substitute for creator evidence.

rules.rule: Legacy skipped payments are provider availability blocks. Do not generate a receipt or infer earnings/pending from booking price. Conflicting existing paid records require review, not deletion.
rules.production_acceptance: Separate genuine event fee records from a skipped court reservation; no blanket deletion by booking status.

rules.rule: Event host/seat fees use the actual saved country-specific fee, not a universal 10%. They are separate from court revenue. Membership fees and shares use saved business/channel/quote; sessions are not new subscription charges.
rules.production_acceptance: Check event/mobile/manual membership/renewal writers and processor evidence. Historical business or channel gaps stay labelled unknown.

rules.rule: Keep both Bright Future venues and Al Sadd owned. Preserve existing external assignments; create separate external businesses for the remaining mapped owned venues. Ownerless business is valid. A non-null business_id alone does not imply external ownership. Optional history restatement requires a reviewed plan and complete sibling fingerprint.
owner_confirmations: Keep both Bright Future venues and Al Sadd
Keep existing external assignments; create businesses for the remaining owned venues
rules.production_acceptance: Validate live identities/effective dates. Freeze excluded siblings before changes. Current business changes must not silently rewrite historical recipients. Transfer reconciliation version must be 3.

rules.rule: Only explicitly reviewed eligible historical customer arrival balances may become provider-direct collected cash. Keep unpaid staff-added bookings pending. Exclude unpaid online, cancelled, refunded, failed, disputed and skipped records.
rules.production_acceptance: Use exact mapped historical cohort, preserve original status/date in audit, label inferred dates and never record this as Bookboll cash or a payout.

rules.rule: For approved historical own-venue customer bookings missing fee/split evidence, allocate 20% to platform and 80% to venue. Exclude staff, skipped, hosted-event, pre-existing allocations, saved quotes and deposit/arrival arrangements. This is a closed historical correction, not a new-booking default rate.
rules.owner_confirmation: for such case please use 20% platform fee for only those bookings that are generated via customer's side... for admin side generated put all 100% in own venue revenue
rules.production_acceptance: Replace preview-specific cohort dependency with a verified source mapping; preserve source amount/status/dates and record fallback basis and owner approval.

rules.rule: Restore exact saved fee/merchant amounts before fallback. For the supported two-receipt pattern, one unique online receipt equals saved fee plus merchant share, both receipts equal booking total, currency/operator match, loyalty is zero and no conflicting allocations exist. Separate balance stays venue revenue.
rules.production_acceptance: Do not recalculate fee on the later balance or generalize this pattern to nonconserving siblings.

rules.rule: Three specifically confirmed paid external receipts formerly labelled full online are entirely retained Bookboll deposits. Match every identity and eligibility fact; no blanket reclassification of other full online payments.
rules.owner_confirmation: They were deposits kept by Bookboll
rules.production_acceptance: Exact matches below only; retain money/status/method/date/processor identity, audit type/recipient/context correction and treat existing correction as no-op.

rules.rule: Bookboll received is paid platform allocations plus paid own venue AFTER fees plus confirmed own unallocated receipts. Gross and its allocations cannot both contribute. Pending/refunded/cancelled/provider-direct cash are not Bookboll received. Currency totals stay separate; these are receipts, not profit.
rules.production_acceptance: Audit paid/pending totals independently from persisted records per currency and parent receipt, including rounding, refunds and ambiguous splits.

rules.rule: Unknown classification stays review and excluded from earnings. Confirmed owned unallocated receipts count once in combined received with separate historical-split disclosure. Preserve provider access only to authorized frozen history; never disclose another business's current booking finances.
rules.production_acceptance: Test super/country/platform/provider owner and staff, ownerless-business staff, missing accept/export capability, transferred venues and foreign filter IDs.

rules.rule: Resolve receipt siblings before applying filters. Summary and rows use the entire authorized set and identical custom dates/status/method/channel/operator/recipient/currency/amount filters. Cache invalidation follows committed mutations; allocations are not extra receipt records.
rules.production_acceptance: Validate shared multi-replica cache/locks and consistent export snapshot during edits. Separate Analytics activity 5,000-record cap still requires its own server aggregate work.

rules.rule: Fixed rent/revenue-share costs follow dated agreements and renewals for Bookboll-operated facilities. Deduct once separately from receipts. External provider arrival balances are not landlord liabilities.
rules.production_acceptance: Agreement storage/tests do not certify complete finance recognition or payments. Verify effective-date/proration/revenue-share calculations and no double cost before enabling profit claims.
